'''Djeon Thilloch''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Order of Revan|Revanite]] during [[Galactic War]]. Around [[3637 BBY]], he was stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]], where he served as a commander at [[Revanite Valley Stronghold]] on [[Sky Ridge Island]]. He was killed by an [[Alliance Commander|ally]] of [[Theron Shan]] who infiltrated the stronghold to free the captured [[Republic Strategic Information Service|SIS]] agent.

==Behind the scenes==
Djeon Thilloch appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]''. He wears full body armor, making it impossible to define his species and appearance.
